## Cold open

> SCENE (states): Baden-Württemberg lights up on the map of Germany.
> Baden-Württemberg | Landeshauptstadt Stuttgart

[dramatic] [[Baden-Württemberg]], in the south-west, borders France and Switzerland. It was formed in 1952, when three post-war states merged into one. It has the Black Forest, Lake Constance, and car makers like Mercedes-Benz and Porsche.

[dramatic] If you take the citizenship test in Baden-Württemberg, three of your thirty-three questions are about the state you live in. They come from a list of just ten. Here are all ten, with the answers.

> SCENE (title): Title card.
> BADEN-WÜRTTEMBERG

## On the map

{Q308}

> SCENE (question): Question card #308. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] The exam shows a map with four states, numbered. [[Welches Bundesland ist Baden-Württemberg?]] Which state is Baden-Württemberg?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[2]]. Number two: the south-west corner of the country.


{Q307}

> SCENE (question): Question card #307. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Die Landeshauptstadt von Baden-Württemberg heißt …]] The state capital of Baden-Württemberg is...

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Stuttgart.]] The other three are real cities in Baden-Württemberg, but not the capital.


## Flag and coat of arms

{Q305}

> SCENE (question): Question card #305. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Welche Farben hat die Landesflagge von Baden-Württemberg?]] What are the colors of the state flag of Baden-Württemberg?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[schwarz-gold]]. Black and gold, the colours of the old Staufer dynasty.


{Q301}

> SCENE (question): Question card #301. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] The exam shows four coats of arms. [[Welches Wappen gehört zum Bundesland Baden-Württemberg?]] Which coat of arms belongs to the state of Baden-Württemberg?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Bild 1]], picture one: three black lions on a golden shield.


## How it's run

{Q302}

> SCENE (question): Question card #302. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Welches ist ein Landkreis in Baden-Württemberg?]] Which of these is a district in Baden-Württemberg?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Neckar-Odenwald-Kreis]]. The others are elsewhere: [[Mecklenburgische Seenplatte]] is in [[Mecklenburg-Vorpommern]], [[Nordfriesland]] is in [[Schleswig-Holstein]], and [[Altötting]] is in [[Bayern]].


{Q303}

> SCENE (question): Question card #303. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Für wie viele Jahre wird der Landtag in Baden-Württemberg gewählt?]] For how many years is the state parliament in Baden-Württemberg elected?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[5]]. Five years, like almost every state parliament.


{Q304}

> SCENE (question): Question card #304. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Ab welchem Alter darf man in Baden-Württemberg bei Kommunalwahlen wählen?]] From what age are you allowed to vote in local elections in Baden-Württemberg?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[16]]. Here, you can vote in local elections from sixteen. It differs from state to state. For the Bundestag, it's eighteen everywhere.


{Q309}

> SCENE (question): Question card #309. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.
> @ Ministerpräsidentin oder Ministerpräsident

[dramatic] [[Wie nennt man die Regierungschefin oder den Regierungschef in Baden-Württemberg?]] What is the head of government in Baden-Württemberg called?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Ministerpräsidentin oder Ministerpräsident]], the minister-president. Not a prime minister, and not a mayor: mayors run towns and cities.


{Q310}

> SCENE (question): Question card #310. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.
> @ Außenministerin oder Außenminister

[dramatic] And a question with a [[nicht]]. [[Welche Ministerin oder welchen Minister hat Baden-Württemberg nicht?]] Which minister does Baden-Württemberg not have?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Außenministerin oder Außenminister]], a foreign minister. Foreign policy is the federation's job, so no state has one. Finance, justice and the interior: every state has those.


{Q306}

> SCENE (question): Question card #306. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Wo können Sie sich in Baden-Württemberg über politische Themen informieren?]] Where can you find information on political topics in Baden-Württemberg?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[bei der Landeszentrale für politische Bildung]], the state centre for civic education. Every state has one. It's free, it belongs to no party, and it has material on politics in plain language.


## What to remember for the exam

> SCENE (words): The words appear one by one, then settle into a grid.
> Stuttgart, schwarz-gold, Ministerpräsident

[dramatic] Three answers to hold on to: [[Stuttgart]]. [[schwarz-gold]]. And [[Ministerpräsident]].
